scientific_content_status: REVISION_COMPLETE AND PUBLISHABLE. Pass-40 closed the evidence and the write-up; pass-41 fixes what pass-40 shipped wrong. Four statements that the revision experiments falsified were still in the text, so the revised paper told a reviewer who had demanded those exact experiments that they were not performed: 'No parameter-sensitivity study was performed', 'a common-NP replication is identified as future work', 'not isolated by a controlled uniform-versus-tiered contrast', and 'the asymmetry was not a controlled variable'. All four are retired. A fifth, 'whether that basis beats coordinate axes ... remains open', is answered for the coordinate arm and kept only for the untested random-orthonormal arm. The Supplementary abstract now enumerates S9 and counts three further releases; the Data Availability Statement names tag v2.14 for the revised version and rev-rel-2026-08-26-dd42d37eb alongside the other releases. No PRIMARY result changed: check_frozen_analysis reports 115/115 byte-identical against rel-2026-07-20-67d9345f9.
freeze_statement: Freeze for publication and resubmission. Two classes of defect are fixed. (1) TEXT: the four falsified statements above, plus a swallowed sentence in conclusions.tex that had shipped in both artifacts -- a Phase-3 patch matched on a LINE PREFIX, so the tail of the real line was appended after a '% BIND:' comment and LaTeX discarded it, leaving the printed paper reading '...for this reason. none exists: no equivalence test...'. The audited anti-equivalence caveat is restored verbatim and placed with the claim it qualifies. A detector for this failure class now exists and the manuscript-wide sweep is clean. (2) TREE: the repository itself was not publishable. It tracked seven copyrighted PDFs, both reviewer reports, the response letter and a co-author handoff carrying biographies marked as awaiting their subjects' approval; an ordinary push would have published all of them, because the exclusions lived only in a build script. 395 files are untracked and pinned in .gitignore, whose reference_papers rule is repaired -- a single-level glob cannot cross a '/', which is why the intended exclusion silently never matched. The revision evidence release recorded absolute local provenance paths across 61 files against the convention of every published release; stripped and re-minted with the correction recorded in the release manifest. All of it is D-0049. TAG: v2.14 is re-cut on the published commit; the pre-existing local v2.14 must never be pushed, because its tree carries the PDFs and both reports.

remint_note: pass-41 RE-MINTED 2026-08-27 after the finalization pass: six reader-facing documents still taught the pre-revision story, the public plain-language summary worst among them, and the rendered S9 claimed a signed pre-registration without naming it. Re-minting rather than advancing to pass-42: pass-41 was never published and nothing was submitted from it, so it remains one internal working freeze. pass-41 supersedes pass-40, which was minted over a corrupted paragraph. The defect was found by reading the built PDF rather than the sources -- the same method that caught pass-39's, and the third time that method has been the one that worked. Every gate passed over the corruption: cross_format_parity was green because BOTH formats agreed, both wrong, and validate_evidence_bindings excludes '% BIND:' comment text from token extraction by design, which is exactly why prose swallowed into one was invisible. The lesson is recorded because it will recur: a multi-line edit whose old-text pattern ends on a PREFIX of a real source line leaves the remainder of that line attached to whatever the replacement ends with. When the replacement ends in a comment, the remainder is silently deleted from the rendered document. Patterns must end on a whole line.
published_commit_note: The pass-41 freeze was taken at anchor_commit in the development line, and that line was SQUASHED into a single commit for publication (D-0049), because its granular history could not be published even though its final tree could. anchor_commit therefore does NOT resolve in this repository's published history; published_commit does, and carries a byte-identical tree.
